details:
pandafortunerush 1.0.0 and 10.0.0 were published to npm on 2026-10-31 by the account amahrou1a, which has no other packages. The archives hold only package.json and README.md. package.json declares a preinstall and a postinstall script, which npm runs on every install. Each is a single node -e command that sends an HTTP GET to http://38.242.235.206/depconf/pandafortunerush/preinstall (or /postinstall) with the user name, the host name and the working directory of the installing machine in the query string, over plain HTTP. The package has no functional code, no repository and no dependencies, and the versions 1.0.0 and 10.0.0 are chosen so that a loose version range resolves to the public package instead of an internal one.

The package description and README call it a defensive placeholder and a benign beacon from a researcher; the code matches that description, and nothing else is done. It still sends identifying data from every machine that installs it to a third party without that machine's consent. The same server, path and command appear in mw-test-utils, mw-communication-client and mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers (MAL-2026-18369, MAL-2026-18370, MAL-2026-18371), published by the account amahrou1w.

Found by Gatekeeper (https://github.com/lb2002/gatekeeper); read statically from the published archives, never executed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
